cards.question:
Adjacent difference tracking

While scanning an array, compute the difference between each adjacent pair.

Detect local maxima

Find every element that is larger than both immediate neighbors.

Count direction changes

Count how many times an array changes from increasing to decreasing or vice versa.

Detect monotonic runs

Identify contiguous increasing or decreasing runs.

Longest monotonic streak

Maintain the number of elements in the longest increasing (or decreasing) streak while scanning.
